vpic: VIN decoding for vehicle year make model equipment body and manufacturer fields.
buyers_guide: Used vehicle sales disclosures, Buyers Guide and the written warranty information supplied by the dealer.
door_campaign: Certain Ford F-150 door latches may freeze and appear closed before opening. Retrieve the recall for review.
bulletins: Search technical service bulletins and manufacturer communications separately from open recalls.
station_fields: Connector type, charging ports, station network, public access, and record date.
rtu: Labeled rooftop unit supply air temperature sensor bias, damper faults, and fault-free runs.
lift: Powered industrial truck inspections and reporting defects found on lift trucks and forklifts.
hvac_check: Commercial building operating schedules and maintenance checklist for facility work handoffs.
anker_011: Anker power bank models A1642, A1647, A1652. Confirm unit identifiers against this notice.
anker_466: Anker power bank models A1647, A1652, A1257, A1681, A1689. Verify the serial number.
printer: Receipt printer paper LED status, low or absent paper roll, device identifiers and panel indicator reference.
frigate: Camera live view remains available while recordings or saved clips are missing.
gtin: Identify trade items with a GTIN and validate which product identifier belongs on the receiving discrepancy.
